name: bro-battles
description: Real-time multiplayer browser battle arena (Phaser, Express, Socket.IO).

scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development nodemon --watch src/server --watch src/shared --ext js,json --exec node src/server/server.js
scripts.test:bots: node --test tests/adaptiveBots.test.js tests/gameRoomStartup.test.js tests/botBehavior.test.js tests/botDash.test.js tests/botDashNavigation.test.js tests/botAiming.test.js tests/botTeamwork.test.js tests/botObjectives.test.js tests/botCoherence.test.js tests/navigationService.test.js
scripts.test:network: node --test tests/networkTiming.test.mjs tests/movementCorrection.test.js tests/serverClockAndHistory.test.js tests/dashNetworkContacts.test.js tests/ninjaCombat.test.js tests/ninjaRenderer.test.js tests/huntressCombat.test.js tests/huntressRenderer.test.js tests/huntressArrows.test.js
scripts.test:db: node tests/siteSupport.integration.cjs && node scripts/db/verify-email-db.cjs && node scripts/db/verify-trophy-road.cjs
